```{r, include=FALSE}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(corrplot)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(DHARMa)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(AICcmodavg)

library(ggstatsplot)

```


# Read in climate and field data
```{r, include=FALSE}
field_climate_08_23_inc <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth_NSavgs.csv", row.names=1, na.strings="NA")%>%
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = (-1*(1 - (SHM/Site_SHM)))*100)%>% #calculate the SHM transfer distance in terms of percent 
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = round(SHM_mult_dist, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(MAT_dist_sq = MAT_dist^2,
         MAP_dist_sq = MAP_dist^2,
         MCMT_dist_sq = MCMT_dist^2,
         TD_dist_sq = TD_dist^2,
         MSP_dist_sq = MSP_dist^2,
         MWMT_dist_sq = MWMT_dist^2,
         CMD_dist_sq = CMD_dist^2,
         CMI_dist_sq = CMI_dist^2,
         SHM_mult_dist_sq = SHM_mult_dist^2) %>%
  mutate(LD = as.factor(if_else(TS == 1, "L",
                      if_else(TS == 2, "L",
                              if_else(TS == 3, "L","D")))))
field_climate_08_23_inc$Unique_ID <- seq_len(nrow(field_climate_08_23_inc))

field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))

live_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>% filter(TS==1|TS==2|TS==3) #7881 live trees assessed

dead_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>%filter(LD=='D') %>%dplyr::select("Unique_ID","LD")
# 302 dead trees assessed for sunken bole, pitching on bole, galls
```

# Crown sparseness
## Percentiles of interest
0 - 0
0.5x - 170
1x - 340
1.5x - 510
2.2x - 748
3x - over 100%

## Sim 1
```{r,echo=FALSE}
set.seed(25)
#0x - 0 trees
sparserand_0 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=0), ] %>% mutate(sparse_0 = 1)

#0.5x - 83 trees
sparserand_05 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=170), ] %>% mutate(sparse_05 = 1)

#1x - 165 trees
sparserand_1 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=340), ] %>% mutate(sparse_1 = 1)

#15x - 331 trees
sparserand_15 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=510), ] %>% mutate(sparse_15 = 1)

#22x - 496 trees
sparserand_22 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=748), ] %>% mutate(sparse_22 = 1)


sparse_sensDD_join <- left_join(dead_trees,sparserand_0, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,sparserand_05, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,sparserand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,sparserand_15, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,sparserand_22, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) 

sparse_sensDD_repl <- sparse_sensDD_join %>%
  mutate(sparserand_0 = if_else(is.na(sparse_0),0, sparse_0))%>%
  mutate(sparserand_05 = if_else(is.na(sparse_05),0, sparse_05))%>%
  mutate(sparserand_1 = if_else(is.na(sparse_1),0, sparse_1))%>%
  mutate(sparserand_15 = if_else(is.na(sparse_15),0, sparse_15))%>%
  mutate(sparserand_22 = if_else(is.na(sparse_22),0, sparse_22))


tmp_sparse_wDD_sims <- left_join(field_climate_08_23_inc,sparse_sensDD_repl, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(sparserand_0:sparserand_22), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), CT_sparse, .)))
```

### Standardized variables
```{r, echo=FALSE}
tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$TD_dist_std <- (tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$TD_dist - mean(tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$TD_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$TD_dist))
tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist_std <- (tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist - mean(tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist))
tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MSP_dist_std <- (tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MSP_dist - mean(tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MSP_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_sparse_wDD_sims$MSP_dist))
```

### Models
```{r, echo=FALSE}
modsparse.OG <- glmmTMB(CT_sparse ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = field_climate_08_23_inc, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modsparse1.DD0x <- glmmTMB(sparserand_0 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_sparse_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modsparse.DD0xboth <- glmmTMB(sparserand_0 ~ MCMT_dist +  I(MCMT_dist^2) + MSP_dist + I(MSP_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_sparse_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))


modsparse1.DD05x <- glmmTMB(sparserand_05 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_sparse_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modsparse1.DD1x <- glmmTMB(sparserand_1 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_sparse_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modsparse1.DD15x <- glmmTMB(sparserand_15 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_sparse_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modsparse1.DD22x <- glmmTMB(sparserand_22 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_sparse_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

```

### Tidy dataframes
```{r,echo=FALSE}
modsparseOG_df<-tidy(modsparse.OG, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
modsparseOG_df$model <- "OG"
modsparseOG_df$multiplier <- "Original model"

sim1sparse0x_df<-tidy(modsparse1.DD0x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1sparse0x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1sparse0x_df$multiplier <- "0"

sim1sparse05x_df<-tidy(modsparse1.DD05x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1sparse05x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1sparse05x_df$multiplier <- "0.5x"

sim1sparse1x_df<-tidy(modsparse1.DD1x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1sparse1x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1sparse1x_df$multiplier <- "1x"

sim1sparse15x_df<-tidy(modsparse1.DD15x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1sparse15x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1sparse15x_df$multiplier <- "1.5x"

sim1sparse22x_df<-tidy(modsparse1.DD22x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1sparse22x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1sparse22x_df$multiplier <- "2.2x"
```

  left_join(.,sparse9rand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,sparse9rand_15, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,sparse9rand_22, by=c("Unique_ID","LD"))

## Coefficient plots
```{r,echo=FALSE}
sparsecoefs_ALL <- read.csv("crownsparsenessProb_sim_coefs.csv")%>% mutate(term = fct_relevel(term, "(Intercept)", "I(TD_dist_std^2)","TD_dist_std","I(MSP_dist_std^2)","MSP_dist_std","I(MCMT_dist_std^2)","MCMT_dist_std")) %>%
  mutate(multiplier = fct_relevel(multiplier, "0","0.5x","1x","1.5x","2.2x", "Original model")) 


pal5_t <- turbo(5, alpha=1, begin=0.2, end=1)
pal6 <- c("#3E9BFEFF", "#46F884FF", "#E1DD37FF", "#F05B12FF", "#7A0403FF","gray")

(coefsparse<- sparsecoefs_ALL %>% filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>% 
              ggplot(aes(estimate, term, color=multiplier, xmin=conf.low,xmax = conf.high)) + 
    theme_classic()+
 
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")+
      geom_point(aes(color=multiplier),
  fill="black",alpha=0.3,pch=21, position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")  +
   scale_color_manual("Multiplier",values=pal6,labels = c('0x', '0.5x', '1x','1.5x','2.2x',"Original model"))+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
  labs(x = "Standardized coefficient",y =NULL, title="Probability of crown sparseness")+
   scale_y_discrete(labels = c(expression(paste("TD"^"2")),"TD",expression(paste("MSP"^"2")),"MSP",expression(paste("MCMT"^"2")),"MCMT"))+
  theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=11)))
ggsave(coefsparse, file="SSMT_FH_sparse_Sensitivity_coefs_title.png", dpi=600, height=6, width=6)

coef2ind<- (coefchlor/coefsparse)
ggsave(coef2ind, file="SSMT_FH_chlorsparse_Sensitivity_coefs_title.png", dpi=600, height=8, width=5)
```

### Multipanel
```{r,echo=FALSE}
Figsparsesensmult <- (psparse0|plot_spacer())/(psparse05low|psparse05high)/(psparse1low|psparse1high)/(psparse15low|psparse15high)/(psparse22low|psparse22high)
Figsparsesensmultann <- Figsparsesensmult + plot_annotation(tag_levels = c("a"))

ggsave(Figsparsesensmultann, file="SSMT_FH_crownsparseness_pred_Sensitivity.png", dpi=600, height=10.5, width=7)
```
